findings.reason: Deliverable A in §6 should declare the serving launcher a thin caller of scripts/nova_lane/run.sh (mode=script over scripts/playable_server/payload.sh), as the test lane already is; otherwise the two copies of the H200 reservation/cache/TMPDIR contract drift independently and neither is the owner.
findings.text: the launcher hand-rolls its own sbatch submission array (partition=betelgeuse, reservation=gpu_0003_grpA, --gpus=h200:1, --mem, --time, the shared interpreter) and its own TMPDIR handling instead of being a thin caller of scripts/nova_lane/run.sh, which the comment at its own header states owns "placement, submission, the rung/job/revision header and the --mem/TMPDIR rules"; scripts/h200_test_lane/run.sh:40 already `exec`s that owner, so this is a second copy of the reservation contract

findings.reason: a serving cache root deliberately isolated from the pinned prewarm cache is a defensible choice rather than a fork of the pin contract, so this is a naming/ownership note and the plan need not change; the cache-contract owner is scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_guard.py.
findings.text: a second compilation-cache root /work/.../playable-serving is hardcoded in the launcher and the payload configures the JAX cache contract itself

findings.reason: two generators of the same control-point set will drift and there is no stated reason ControlPoints cannot be extended (a supplied commanded axis/gap set); the plan should extend ControlPoints or say why the steering vocabulary must diverge from it.
findings.text: PlasmaShape.control_points re-derives the outer/upper/inner/lower/X-point geometry inline and explicitly only "match[es] the pulse-design ControlPoints convention" rather than using nova/geometry/plasmapoints.py:143 ControlPoints / PlasmaPoints, which the plan's §2 names as the generator of that point set from axis, minor radius, elongation, triangularities and squareness

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the SteeringFrame contract in nova/equilibrium/steering_frames.py confines the per-frame record shape, the group-backed netCDF session store and the assemble/read join (assemble_frame, write_session, read_session, frames_from_session) behind a small interface over ~1950 lines, and budgets the renderer channels out of it.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — scripts/playable_server/run.sh forks the compute-lane submission path that scripts/nova_lane/run.sh owns and that scripts/h200_test_lane is already a thin caller of.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan cites the forward inverse design, the pulse-design control points and the pulsedesign view, but proposes new H200 serving-launch machinery without citing scripts/nova_lane/run.sh, the repository's compute-lane launcher that owns placement and submission.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — apps/playable/shape.py adds a PlasmaShape control-point holder that re-derives the control-point geometry inline instead of reusing or extending nova/geometry/plasmapoints.py, whose generator the plan names in §2.
